manifestations.description: left lower limb numbness (pins-and-needles) from left lower back to lateral and posterior left thigh, leg and ankle
left calf and left foot weakness and tremor
unable to sleep in the supine position or sleep on his left side
condition deteriorates when standing or walking for a long period
difficulty carrying weight of 5 kg for 10 minutes
subjective complaints described as mild; objective signs not supporting serious back injury (e.g. normal lower limb power and sensation recorded in medical notes)

source: On 10 November 2014 when he first attended the A&E department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (“TKOH”) he told the doctor that he had sustained “sprain back when heavy lifting at work (sic)”

treatments_received.treatment: follow-up outpatient consultations at Tseung Kwan O Po Ning Road General Out-patient Clinic and Tseung Kwan O Jockey Club General Outpatient Clinic
source: He then had follow-up consultation in Tseung Kwan O Po Ning Road General Out-patient Clinic (“PNRGOC”) and Tseung Kwan O Jockey Club General Outpatient Clinic (“JCGOC”) for his alleged persistent back pain at PNRGOC during the period from 17 November 2014 to 9 February 2015. He resumed his medical consultation at JCGOC on 7 July 2015 until 2 September 2015.
The plaintiff also received 4 physiotherapy treatments at a private physiotherapy & rehabilitation clinic during the period from 8 December 2014 to 23 January 2015.

according to the physiotherapy progress note of PD dated 9 March 2016, it was recorded that during the period from 6 July 2015 until 9 March 2016, the plaintiff had received 28 physiotherapy treatment sessions.
In another physiotherapy progress note dated 18 May 2017, it was recorded that the plaintiff had received 18 physiotherapy treatments in 30 weeks.

On 27December 2014, MRI on the plaintiff was done and it was revealed that there was a slight posterior prolapse of the T11/12 disc and early dehydration of the lumbar and lower thoracic discs detected but no significant nerve impingement.

On 11 June 2016, another MRI on the plaintiff was done and it was revealed that: (i) normal lumbar alignment; (ii) mild disc desiccation at T11/12 & T12/L1; (iii) L5/S1. There is mild left lateral disc protrusion with no significant compression; and (iv) lower thoracic spine showed mild left paracentral disc protrusion.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Plaintiff allegedly has to refrain from participating in sports and activities such as playing basketball, cycling, jogging and hiking as before
